Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear note and attachments. Looping in Kimberly (billing ops) and Ben (account success) so we can cover onboarding and any PO exceptions.

Short answers up front:
- Recommendation: portal-first for EU customers who need long-term VAT evidence retention. Our portal provides SAML SSO, per-statement audit trail, and a downloadable consolidated monthly statement (PDF) with embedded VAT metadata.
- For the initial payment we can do a one-time signed PDF push to accounts@greenline.com (PGP or TLS-delivered signed PDF) while you complete portal credentialing.
- We support SFTP and webhook delivery as alternatives if you need an automated machine-to-machine flow.

Options (pick one primary + optional email copies):
1) Portal primary: enroll Greenline account, monthly consolidated statement + on-demand invoice downloads. Email copies to up to 2 AP recipients during the first 30 days.
2) SFTP push: daily/weekly invoice bundles, VAT metadata in accompanying XML.
3) Email push: signed PDF per invoice (PGP) — best for smaller volumes or legal signoff requests.

Action items we need from you to proceed:
- Confirm primary channel (Portal / SFTP / Email).
- Confirm billing contact(s) + desired email copies for the first 30 days.
- Confirm whether you require PGP-signed PDF or just TLS-signed attachments for the initial invoice.

I'm attaching our onboarding checklist (redwood_onboarding_checklist.xlsx) and an example of the initial_signed_invoice we'll send for the cutover.

If portal is OK, Kimberly can start the SAML enrollment and send an invite link. If you prefer email for the initial invoice, we'll schedule that for the first issuance window (we close daily at 16:00 UTC).

Best regards,
